scope: Human review of targeted MS1 EIC shape and retention-time coordinates only
non_gating_rule: Human MS1 labels do not directly alter MS2 same-compound identity status

adjudication.class_disagreement: required when two non-uncertain reviewer classes differ

automatic_consensus.rule: baseline and experimental models must return the same class and each peak RT must agree within 0.05 min
automatic_consensus.calibration_state: development-set abstention rule; requires independent validation
